name: Plank shoulder tap
summary: From a high plank, lift one hand to tap the opposite shoulder without the hips turning.
setup: High plank facing the phone, feet a little wider than the hips. Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder, replace it, then the other. Keep the hips dead still.
why: The hand crosses the body and the hips twist toward the phone — a top-down detail. Logged by hand.

faults.label: Hips rocking side to side
faults.tip: Widen the feet and brace before each tap; if the hips rock, slow down.

faults.label: Tapping quickly
faults.tip: Slow taps are the anti-rotation work; fast taps are just a plank with wobble.

faults.label: Feet too close
faults.tip: A wide base is what lets the hips stay level while a hand lifts.

points.t: Taps the opposite shoulder and returns.
